内容.differentiation_en: Based on Uniswap v4-style hook pools (not traditional bonding curve); creators set total fee 1%-10%, split by market-cap band into creator/protocol/coin-support. Protocol fees 90% for KNTQ and HYPE purchases. Per Ascend official docs.
内容.differentiation_zh: 基于Uniswap v4 Hook风格池（而非传统联合曲线），创作者可设总费1%-10%，按市值带分配创作者/协议/币支持份额。协议费90%用于KNTQ与HYPE购买。据Ascend官方文档。
内容.fee_split_en: Base trading fee 1%, creator can raise to 10%, excess to creator allocation. Split by market-cap band (e.g. <$40k creator ~0.35%, protocol 0.65%); protocol fees 10% treasury, 90% purchases (80% KNTQ, 20% HYPE). Creator chooses direct payout, holder rewards or buyback config. Per Ascend docs.
内容.fee_split_zh: 基础交易费1%，创作者可上调至10%，超额归创作者分配。按市值带（如<$40k创作者约0.35%、协议0.65%）分配；协议费10%金库、90%购买（80% KNTQ、20% HYPE）。创作者可选择直接支付、持有人奖励或回购配置。据Ascend docs。
内容.one_liner_en: Token launchpad on Elysium (Kinetiq's Hyperliquid-related L2), using KNTQ as protocol token.
内容.one_liner_zh: Elysium（Kinetiq Hyperliquid系L2）上的代币发射台，采用KNTQ作为协议币。
risks_en: Some features (staking etc.) not yet live
risks_zh: 新链（2026年11月主网上线），活动有限
部分功能（质押等）尚未上线
selling_points_en: Supports USDC, HYPE, KNTQ and other quotes
Creators can configure fees and allocations (holder rewards, buybacks etc.)
No separate Ascend token, uses KNTQ
Most protocol fees for KNTQ/HYPE purchases
selling_points_zh: 创作者可配置费用与分配（持有人奖励、回购等）
协议费大部分用于KNTQ/HYPE购买
内容.team_en: Affiliated with Kinetiq and Elysium. Elysium is Kinetiq-built Hyperliquid-related L2. Specific independent team and funding not mentioned. Per Kinetiq blog and Ascend docs.
内容.team_zh: 与Kinetiq及Elysium关联。Elysium为Kinetiq构建的Hyperliquid系L2。具体独立团队与融资资料未提及。据Kinetiq博客与Ascend docs。
内容.token_en: No independent platform token; adopts Kinetiq's KNTQ. Protocol fees used to buy KNTQ (partial burn). Per official docs.
内容.token_zh: 无独立平台币；采用Kinetiq的KNTQ。协议费用于购买KNTQ（部分销毁）。据官方文档。
unknowns_en: Long-term protocol fee purchase execution details
unknowns_zh: 长期协议费购买执行细节

内容.differentiation_en: Core difference is strong fee-sharing: default 2% trade fee sends roughly half to creator pool, allocable to multiple wallets; deployer gets 25% of pool on new configs. Suited for multi-collaborator projects. Per Bags docs and MemeFees.
内容.differentiation_zh: 核心差异是强大的费用分享机制：默认2%交易费中约一半进入创作者池，可分配给多钱包，部署者在新配置中获池的25%。适合多合作者项目。据Bags文档与MemeFees。
内容.fee_split_en: Default mode: 2% pre-migration (1% protocol / 1% creator), post-migration 2% (0.75% protocol / 0.75% creator / 0.5% compounding). New SOL configs give deployer 25% of creator pool. Other modes range 0.25%-10%. Per Bags docs.
内容.fee_split_zh: 默认模式：曲线前2%（协议1%/创作者1%），毕业后2%（协议0.75%/创作者0.75%/复利0.5%）。新SOL配置中部署者获创作者池25%。其他模式费率从0.25%到10%不等。据Bags文档。
内容.one_liner_en: Creator-first launchpad on Solana and Robinhood Chain that by default sends half of trading fees to creators (splittable among up to 100 recipients).
内容.one_liner_zh: Solana与Robinhood Chain上的创作者优先发射台，默认将交易费的一半分给创作者（可拆分给多达100人）。
risks_en: Default fee higher than some competitors
risks_zh: 默认费率高于部分竞品
创作者费用需手动领取
selling_points_en: Fees splittable among up to 100 recipients
Built on Meteora DBC, graduates to DAMM v2
selling_points_zh: 创作者可长期获得交易费分成
费用可拆分给最多100个接收方
内容.team_en: Core team identity and funding not detailed in materials. Operates via bags.fm, multi-chain. Per project pages.
内容.team_zh: 资料未详细提及核心团队身份与融资。通过bags.fm运营，支持多链。据项目页。
内容.token_en: No independent platform token. Revenue via protocol fee share. Per public materials.
内容.token_zh: 无独立平台币。收益主要通过协议费份额实现。据公开资料。

内容.differentiation_en: As a third-party platform on Raydium LaunchLab, differs from pure pump.fun-style by routing most revenue to BONK ecosystem (including Bonk Inc. purchases), with curve creator fee often set to 0. Graduation around 85 SOL. Per MemeFees and Raydium analyses.
内容.differentiation_zh: 作为Raydium LaunchLab上的第三方平台，与纯pump.fun式不同之处在于收益主要流向BONK生态（包括Bonk Inc.购买），曲线创作者费常设为0。毕业约85 SOL。据MemeFees与Raydium相关分析。
内容.fee_split_en: Curve trade ~1.5% (platform 1.25% + Raydium 0.25%), curve creator fee usually 0%. Revenue split includes ~51% for Bonk Inc. BONK purchases, plus staking, marketing, GP reserve etc. Post-graduation CPMM fees separate, some to platform-controlled address. Per DefiLlama methodology, MemeFees and reports (adjusted after June 2025).
内容.fee_split_zh: 曲线交易约1.5%（平台1.25% + Raydium 0.25%），曲线创作者费通常0%。收益分配包括约51%用于Bonk Inc.购买BONK、其他用于质押、营销、GP储备等。毕业后CPMM费用另计，部分归平台控制地址。据DefiLlama方法论、MemeFees与相关报道（2025年6月后调整）。
内容.one_liner_en: BONK community Solana memecoin launchpad on Raydium LaunchLab, with part of revenue buying BONK.
内容.one_liner_zh: 基于Raydium LaunchLab的BONK社区Solana模因币发射台，收益部分用于购买BONK。
risks_en: Revenue purchases may go to company treasury not burn
risks_zh: 创作者费常为0，激励较弱
收益购买可能进入公司金库而非销毁
selling_points_en: Built on Raydium LaunchLab, graduates to Raydium pools
Majority of platform revenue used for BONK-related purchases
selling_points_zh: 平台收益大部分用于BONK相关购买
内容.team_en: Related to BONK community; Graphite Protocol holds ~38% and provides tech. Bonk Inc. holds 51% revenue interest. Core operators include related contributors. Per official, Graphite and reports.
内容.team_zh: BONK社区相关，Graphite Protocol持有约38%股权并提供技术。Bonk Inc.持有51%收益权益。核心运营者包括相关贡献者。据官网、Graphite与报道。
内容.token_en: No independent platform token; uses BONK. Part of revenue buys BONK (some to company treasury rather than pure burn). Per reports.
内容.token_zh: 无独立平台币；使用BONK。收益部分购买BONK（部分进入公司金库而非纯销毁）。据报道。
unknowns_en: Actual payout mechanism for creator rewards
unknowns_zh: 精确当前费率配置细节
创作者奖励的实际支付机制

内容.differentiation_en: New token standard (BTS) allows in-trade hooks, not standard SPL. Curve graduates to Bordrless DEX. Fees configurable for creator/holders/protocol. Per docs and X.
内容.differentiation_zh: 新代币标准（BTS）允许交易内hooks，非标准SPL。曲线毕业至Bordrless DEX。费可配置创作者/持有人/协议。据文档与X。
内容.fee_split_en: Pool fee ~0.3% (higher early). Creator fee settable (e.g. 0.5-2%). Platform takes 25% of rules-collected. Protocol fee half buys back $BORDR. Per docs and DefiLlama.
内容.fee_split_zh: 池费约0.3%（早期更高）。创作者费可设（如0.5-2%）。平台取规则收集的25%。协议费一半回购$BORDR。据文档与DefiLlama。
内容.one_liner_en: Solana programmable token standard and launchpad; supports hooks, custom fees; graduates to own DEX.
内容.one_liner_zh: Solana可编程代币标准与发射台，支持hooks、自定义费、毕业至自有DEX。
内容.team_en: Not detailed. Operates via Bordrless related projects.
内容.team_zh: 资料未详细提及。通过bordrless相关项目运营。
内容.token_en: Has platform token $BORDR. Half of protocol fee used for buyback. Per DefiLlama.
内容.token_zh: 有平台币$BORDR。协议费一半用于回购。据DefiLlama。

内容.differentiation_en: Compared to pure bonding-curve, emphasizes programmable taxes and vaults (dividends in any ERC-20, buybacks etc.) plus Pool Launch direct-to-pool option. Graduation typically after 80% supply sold. Per official docs.
内容.differentiation_zh: 与纯联合曲线相比，强调可编程税收与金库（可分红任意ERC-20、回购等），并提供Pool Launch直接进池选项。毕业通常在80%供应售出后。据官网文档。
内容.fee_split_en: Bonding-curve protocol fee 1% (BSC, Robinhood, X Layer, Monad; 2.5% on Morph), stops after graduation. Tax tokens additional protocol rate up to 0.3%. Creation basically free (gas only). Tax set by creator and routed to vaults/holders. Per official protocol economics and guides.
内容.fee_split_zh: 联合曲线协议费1%（BSC、Robinhood、X Layer、Monad；Morph为2.5%），毕业后停止。税收代币额外协议率最高0.3%。创建基本免费（仅gas）。税收由创作者设定并路由至金库/持有人。据官网protocol economics与相关指南。
内容.one_liner_en: Multi-chain EVM programmable launchpad supporting tax tokens that can route taxes as holder dividends.
内容.one_liner_zh: EVM多链可编程发射台，支持税收代币并可将税收转化为持有人分红。
risks_en: Tax tokens can raise trading costs
risks_zh: 税收代币可能增加交易成本
selling_points_en: Supports tax tokens with custom dividend vaults
Graduates to major DEX like PancakeSwap
selling_points_zh: 支持税收代币与自定义分红金库
无需编写合约一键创建
内容.team_en: Originated from ETHGlobal hackathon. PitchBook lists founded 2024, Lisbon Portugal, accelerator-backed (Unicorn Factory Lisboa). Full named team and funding details not mentioned. Per docs and PitchBook.
内容.team_zh: 源自ETHGlobal黑客松。PitchBook显示2024年成立、葡萄牙里斯本、加速器支持（Unicorn Factory Lisboa）。完整实名团队与融资细节资料未提及。据文档与PitchBook。
内容.token_en: No platform token mentioned in available sources.

内容.differentiation_en: Not a pure launchpad itself but provides tech and partial ownership for LetsBONK.fun etc., with revenue flowing back to GP. Differs from pump.fun-style as infrastructure layer rather than direct UI. Per official site.
内容.differentiation_zh: 本身不是纯发射台，而是提供LetsBONK.fun等发射台的技术与部分所有权，收益回流GP。与pump.fun式不同在于作为基础设施层而非直接用户界面。据官网。
内容.fee_split_en: Receives ~40% (later adjusted) or similar share from LetsBONK.fun JV revenue, of which 7.6% for GP buyback and burn, rest for ops, development etc. Specifics adjusted over time. Per official site, DefiLlama adapter and X posts.
内容.fee_split_zh: 从LetsBONK.fun合资收益中获约40%（后调整）或类似份额，其中7.6%用于GP回购销毁，其余用于运营、开发等。具体随时间调整。据官网、DefiLlama适配器与X帖子。
内容.one_liner_en: Protocol developed by Taiyo Robotics that tech-supports LetsBONK.fun and holds part ownership, with revenue for GP buybacks.
内容.one_liner_zh: Taiyo Robotics开发的协议，技术支持LetsBONK.fun并持有其部分股权，收益用于GP回购。
risks_en: Highly dependent on single product LetsBONK.fun
History involves NFTs and other products
risks_zh: 团队与实体透明度一般
selling_points_en: 7.6% of revenue for GP buyback and burn
内容.team_en: Developed and operated by Taiyo Robotics. Early angel round ~$1.4M led by SOLBigBrain. Per X posts and project pages.
内容.team_zh: 由Taiyo Robotics开发运营。早期天使轮融资约140万美元（SOLBigBrain领投）。据X帖子与项目页。
内容.token_en: Has platform token GP. Part of revenue (~7.6%) used for buyback and burn. Per official site and X.
内容.token_zh: 有平台币GP。收益部分（约7.6%）用于回购并销毁。据官网与X。

内容.differentiation_en: Solves traditional Raydium launch needing pre-seeded liquidity by using bonding curve. Supports multiple curve formulas (common quadratic), third parties can configure platform/creator fees, post-graduation LP allocated or burned per platform config. Per Raydium docs.
内容.differentiation_zh: 解决传统Raydium发射需预存流动性的问题，用联合曲线替代。支持多种曲线公式（常见二次），第三方可配置平台/创作者费用，毕业后LP按平台配置分配或销毁。据Raydium文档。
内容.fee_split_en: Curve phase default ~1% (50% to pool seed, 50% protocol treasury), configurable platform fee, creator fee (up to ~0.5%), referral 0.1%. Creation ~0.1 SOL platform fee + rent. Post-graduation CPMM standard 0.25% (LP/protocol/fund split). Aug 2026 upgrade adjusted LP fee-key distribution. Per Raydium fee comparison and creator fees docs.
内容.fee_split_zh: 曲线阶段默认约1%（50%进池种子、50%协议金库），可配置平台费、创作者费（最高约0.5%）、推荐费0.1%。创建约0.1 SOL平台费+租金。毕业后CPMM标准0.25%（LP/协议/基金分成）。2026年8月升级调整LP费用键分配。据Raydium费用对比与创作者费用文档。
内容.one_liner_en: Raydium's Solana bonding-curve launch protocol that graduates to Raydium CPMM without pre-seeded liquidity.
内容.one_liner_zh: Raydium的Solana联合曲线发射协议，毕业后进入Raydium CPMM，无需预存流动性。
risks_en: Fees configured by platforms, third parties may set high fees
No single fixed rate, must check per project
risks_zh: 费用由平台配置，第三方可能设置高费
无统一固定费率，需逐项目检查
selling_points_en: Launch without pre-seeding both sides of liquidity
Graduates directly into Raydium main pools
Supports third-party platforms with custom fee splits
Liquidity locked or burned after graduation
selling_points_zh: 无需预存双边流动性即可发射
毕业后直接进入Raydium主流池
支持第三方平台自定义费用分成
流动性毕业后锁定或销毁
内容.team_en: Developed and operated by the Raydium team as one of Raydium's products. Raydium is an established Solana DEX. Specific independent funding for LaunchLab not mentioned.
内容.team_zh: 由Raydium团队开发运营，作为Raydium产品之一。Raydium为成熟Solana DEX项目。具体LaunchLab独立融资资料未提及。
内容.token_en: No independent platform token; uses Raydium ecosystem (RAY etc.). No dedicated buyback mentioned.
内容.token_zh: 无独立平台币；使用Raydium生态（RAY等）。资料未提及专门回购。
unknowns_en: Specific fee distributions of third-party platforms
unknowns_zh: 各第三方平台的具体费率分布
精确默认毕业阈值细节

内容.differentiation_en: Protocol-level tool rather than independent frontend. Bonding curve ~0.5% protocol + 0.6% creator; similar post-grad CPMM. Supports launch pools and presales. Per official fee docs.
内容.differentiation_zh: 作为协议级工具而非独立前端。Bonding curve费约0.5%协议+0.6%创作者；毕业后CPMM类似。支持launch pool与presale。据官方费用文档。
内容.fee_split_en: Bonding curve: protocol ~0.50%, creator 0.60%. Post-grad CPMM protocol 0.40%, creator 0.60% etc. Launch pool deposit/withdraw 2%, graduation 5%. Per protocol fees page.
内容.fee_split_zh: Bonding curve：协议约0.50%、创作者0.60%。毕业后CPMM协议0.40%、创作者0.60%等。Launch pool存款/提款2%，毕业5%。据协议费用页。
内容.one_liner_en: Metaplex Genesis launch platform; supports bonding curve and launch pools; graduates to Raydium.
内容.one_liner_zh: Metaplex的Genesis发射平台，支持bonding curve与launch pool，毕业至Raydium。
内容.team_en: Operated by Metaplex Foundation. Per official docs.
内容.team_zh: 由Metaplex Foundation运营。据官方文档。
内容.token_en: MPLX (Metaplex's token). Grok's two answers disagree on whether protocol fees buy it back; unverified.
内容.token_zh: 有 MPLX（Metaplex 的代币）。Grok 两次回答对它是否用协议费回购说法不一，未核实。

内容.differentiation_en: Allocates fees via public wallets: ~67.5% to holders (buying tokenized stocks etc.), 10% OTC buyback/burn, rest to protocol and desks. Emphasizes transparency and holder value. Per OTC-related pages.
内容.differentiation_zh: 通过公开钱包分配费用：约67.5%给持有人（购买代币化股票等）、10%回购销毁OTC、其他给协议与桌面。强调透明与持有人价值。据OTC相关页面。
内容.fee_split_en: Claimed ~67.5% holders, 10% desk pot, 10% buyback/burn, 12.5% protocol. Extracted from launch fees. Per public wallet descriptions.
内容.fee_split_zh: 声称约67.5%持有人、10%桌面池、10%回购销毁、12.5%协议。具体从发射费用中提取。据公开钱包说明。
内容.one_liner_en: Solana launchpad emphasizing holder rewards and OTC token buyback/burn, with fees partially used to buy tokenized stocks etc.
内容.one_liner_zh: Solana发射台，强调持有人奖励与OTC代币回购销毁，费用部分用于购买代币化股票等。
risks_en: Complex mechanism relying on multiple wallets
selling_points_en: Holders receive majority of fee allocation
Fixed share for OTC buyback and burn
selling_points_zh: 持有人获大部分费用分配
固定比例用于OTC回购销毁
内容.team_en: Not detailed in materials. Operates via related domains and public wallets.
内容.team_zh: 资料未详细提及。通过相关域名与公开钱包运营。
内容.token_en: Has platform token OTC. Part of fees used for open-market buyback and burn. Per related docs.
内容.token_zh: 有平台币OTC。部分费用用于公开市场回购并销毁。据相关文档。
unknowns_en: Exact current rates and execution details
unknowns_zh: 精确当前费率与执行细节
长期持有人分配稳定性

内容.differentiation_en: Compared to standard bonding curve, allows quoting against tokenized stocks etc., graduates to Uniswap V4 with custom hook and permanently locked LP. V2 introduces curve phase (V1 was direct pool). Per multiple on-chain analyses and docs.
内容.differentiation_zh: 与标准联合曲线相比，允许以代币化股票等资产报价，毕业进入自定义Hook的Uniswap V4池且LP永久锁定。V2引入曲线阶段（V1为直接池）。据多份链上分析与文档。
内容.fee_split_en: Creation fee ~0.0005 ETH. Curve/pool base fee ~1%, typically 70% creator / 30% protocol (protocol share mostly for PONS buyback/burn). Optional creator tax up to 10%. Opening anti-snipe tax (decays from high). Graduation threshold ~4.2 ETH for ETH quotes. Per multiple guides and on-chain data.
内容.fee_split_zh: 创建费约0.0005 ETH。曲线/池基础费约1%，通常70%创作者/30%协议（协议部分多用于PONS回购销毁）。可选创作者税最高10%。有开盘反狙击税（从高衰减）。毕业阈值对ETH报价约4.2 ETH。据多份指南与链上数据。
内容.one_liner_en: Robinhood Chain bonding-curve launchpad supporting tokenized stock quotes, graduating to locked Uniswap V4 pool.
内容.one_liner_zh: Robinhood Chain上的联合曲线发射台，支持代币化股票报价，毕业后进入锁定Uniswap V4池。
risks_en: Early activity volatile, fees fell from peak
Tokenized stock quotes may carry regulatory risk
Anti-snipe tax may affect ordinary users
risks_zh: 早期活动波动大，费用曾从高峰回落
代币化股票报价可能带来监管风险
反狙击税可能影响普通用户
selling_points_en: Supports ETH, stables and tokenized stocks as quote assets
Creators receive high share of trade fees
Platform token PONS with buyback and burn
selling_points_zh: 支持ETH、稳定币及代币化股票作为报价资产
流动性毕业后永久锁定
创作者获得高比例交易费分成
内容.team_en: Operated by Pons Labs, LLC. Core founder is pseudonymous Ozzy (@MEADGod), previously of RootsFi. Full named team not mentioned. Per reports.
内容.team_zh: 由Pons Labs, LLC运营。核心创始人为化名Ozzy（@MEADGod），此前有RootsFi项目。完整实名团队资料未提及。据报道。
内容.token_en: Has platform token PONS. No presale team allocation; majority of protocol revenue used for buyback and burn. Per reports and related DefiLlama data.
内容.token_zh: 有平台币PONS。无预售团队分配，协议收入大部分用于回购销毁。据报道与DefiLlama相关数据。
unknowns_zh: 完整团队身份与融资方
精确当前费率（因配置可变）

内容.differentiation_en: Similar to typical bonding-curve platforms but graduates to its own PumpSwap (not external DEX), with market-cap-tiered fees, app platform fee, and creator fee sharing. Graduation around 85 SOL with LP burned. Per official docs and DefiLlama.
内容.differentiation_zh: 与典型联合曲线平台类似，但自建PumpSwap作为毕业去向（而非依赖外部DEX），并引入市场资本分层的手续费、应用平台费以及创作者费用共享。毕业阈值约85 SOL，流动性迁移后LP销毁。据官网文档与DefiLlama。
内容.fee_split_en: Creation free. Bonding curve 1.25% total (creator 0.30%, protocol 0.95%, LP 0%) from May 13 2025. PumpSwap market-cap tiered (total 1.25% to 0.30%, creator up to 0.95%). Graduation 0.015 SOL. App platform fee 0.45% (0.40% with code) from Oct 17 2026. Protocol revenue partly buys/burns PUMP. Per official fees page and DefiLlama.
内容.fee_split_zh: 创建免费。联合曲线交易总费1.25%（创作者0.30%、协议0.95%、LP 0%），自2025年5月13日起适用。PumpSwap按市值分层（总费从1.25%降至0.30%，创作者最高0.95%）。毕业费0.015 SOL。自2026年10月17日起应用内额外平台费0.45%（推荐码0.40%）。协议收入部分用于PUMP回购销毁。据官网fees页与DefiLlama。
内容.one_liner_en: Solana bonding-curve launchpad for free one-click memecoin creation that graduates to its own PumpSwap.
内容.one_liner_zh: Solana上免费一键创建模因币的联合曲线发射台，毕业后进入自有PumpSwap。
risks_en: Vast majority of tokens never graduate
App platform fee increases trading cost
risks_zh: 2024年5月曾发生约200万美元私钥泄露事件
绝大多数代币无法毕业
应用内额外平台费增加交易成本
多链扩展可能带来复杂性
selling_points_en: Free token creation with no pre-seeded liquidity
Fair launch with no team allocation
Creators earn ongoing share of trade fees
Supports multi-chain trading and in-app features
selling_points_zh: 免费创建代币，无需预存流动性
公平发射无团队预分配
创作者从交易费中持续获得分成
支持多链交易与应用内功能
内容.team_en: Operated by Baton Corporation Ltd (UK-registered). Founders include Alon Cohen, Noah Tweedale, Dylan Kerler. Launched January 2024. Per official Terms, Wikipedia and reports.
内容.team_zh: 由Baton Corporation Ltd（英国注册）运营。创始人包括Alon Cohen、Noah Tweedale、Dylan Kerler。2024年1月上线。据官网Terms、Wikipedia与相关报道。
内容.token_en: Has platform token PUMP. Sold July 2025 (~$1B total: $400M private + $600M ICO). Used for revenue share; protocol claims ~half of net revenue buys and burns on open market. Per DefiLlama and reports.
内容.token_zh: 有平台币PUMP。2025年7月销售（总计约10亿美元：4亿私人+6亿ICO）。用途包括收益分享，协议宣称约一半净收入用于公开市场回购并销毁。据DefiLlama与相关报道。
unknowns_en: Exact official fixed SOL graduation threshold
Long-term stability of app platform fee
unknowns_zh: 精确毕业SOL阈值的官方固定数字
应用平台费的长期稳定性

内容.differentiation_en: Tooling layer rather than independent curve launchpad. Users deploy on pump.fun etc. via it; charges deployment and tool fees. Per DefiLlama and site.
内容.differentiation_zh: 工具层而非独立曲线发射台。用户通过它在pump.fun等平台部署，收取部署与工具费。据DefiLlama与官网。
内容.fee_split_en: Mainly charges deployment and tool SOL fees. ~86% retained, 14% to referrals. Not standard trading fee structure. Per DefiLlama methodology.
内容.fee_split_zh: 主要收取部署与工具SOL费。约86%留存，14%推荐分。非标准交易费结构。据DefiLlama方法论。
内容.one_liner_en: Multi-launchpad deployment toolkit, not a single launchpad; supports bundling and cross-platform rapid deploys.
内容.one_liner_zh: 多发射台部署工具包，非单一发射台，支持bundling与跨平台快速部署。
内容.team_zh: 资料未详细提及。通过rapidlaunch.io运营。

内容.differentiation_en: Unique floor mechanism: protocol is sole counterparty; liquidity reallocates to floor. No traditional graduation. 1.25% trade fee splits to protocol/floor/creator. Per docs.
内容.differentiation_zh: 独特地板机制：协议为唯一对手方，流动性重分配至地板。无传统毕业。交易1.25%费分协议/地板/创作者。据文档。
内容.fee_split_en: Trades 1.25% (split protocol, floor, creator). Borrows one-off 3% with no ongoing interest. Creation ~0.05 SOL. Per fee docs and DefiLlama.
内容.fee_split_zh: 交易1.25%（分协议、地板、创作者）。借贷一次性3%无持续利息。创建约0.05 SOL。据费用文档与DefiLlama。
内容.one_liner_en: Solana floor-price protected launchpad; protocol-owned liquidity; supports interest-free borrows and no-liquidation loops.
内容.one_liner_zh: Solana地板价保护发射台，协议持有流动性，支持无息借贷与无清算循环。
内容.team_en: Not detailed publicly. Operates via rise.rich. Per docs.
内容.team_zh: 资料未详细公开。通过rise.rich运营。据文档。
内容.token_zh: 资料未提及独立平台币。

内容.differentiation_en: Emphasizes ZEC and privacy: via Raydium LaunchLab or older pump.fun path; 2% fee splits to SAPLING burn, liquidity, flywheel and treasury; deployer can add up to 3% for holders. Per site.
内容.differentiation_zh: 强调ZEC与隐私：通过Raydium LaunchLab或旧pump.fun路径，2%费分至SAPLING销毁、流动性、飞轮与国库，部署者可额外加至3%给持有人。据官网。
内容.fee_split_en: Raydium coins: Sapling takes 2% (0.50% each to SAPLING burn, SAPLING/ZEC pool, flywheel, treasury). Deployer adds 0-3% (optional to holders). Older coins similar split. Per docs.
内容.fee_split_zh: Raydium币：Sapling收2%（各0.50%至SAPLING销毁、SAPLING/ZEC池、飞轮、国库）。部署者额外0-3%（可选持有人）。旧币类似分层。据文档。
内容.one_liner_en: Zcash-native Solana launchpad; coins paired with ZEC etc.; 2% fee mostly for buyback/burn and holder rewards.
内容.one_liner_zh: Zcash原生Solana发射台，币配对ZEC等，2%费多用于回购销毁与持有人奖励。
risks_en: New platform with small market share
risks_zh: 隐私功能可能增加复杂性
内容.team_en: Sapling Technologies LLC (Wyoming), founder igor. Per FAQ and X.
内容.token_en: Has platform token $SAPLING. Part of fees used for buyback and burn (significant portion already burned). Per project data.
内容.token_zh: 有平台币$SAPLING。部分费用于回购销毁（已销毁显著比例）。据项目数据。

内容.differentiation_en: Core difference is creator chooses quote asset (e.g. tokenized stock) instead of fixed SOL. Uses Raydium LaunchLab or CLMM, supports reward-coin transfer tax. Per related official and analysis articles.
内容.differentiation_zh: 核心不同是创作者选择报价资产（如代币化股票），而非固定SOL。使用Raydium LaunchLab或CLMM，支持奖励币转账税。据官网相关与分析文章。
内容.fee_split_en: Standard mode pool fee 1% or 2%, creator gets about half (1% pool ~0.5%). Reward coins use 1%-3% transfer tax to holders. Platform revenue ~60% for STONK buyback and burn. Plus flywheel buying top coins. Per community docs and reports.
内容.fee_split_zh: 标准模式池费1%或2%，创作者约获一半（1%池约0.5%）。奖励币用1%-3%转账税给持有人。平台收入约60%用于STONK回购销毁。另有飞轮回购顶级币。据社区文档与报道。
内容.one_liner_en: Solana launchpad allowing tokens to pair with tokenized stocks or any asset, not just SOL.
内容.one_liner_zh: Solana发射台，允许代币与代币化股票等任意资产配对，而非仅SOL。
risks_en: Quote asset volatility and regulatory risk
risks_zh: 曾受域名攻击影响网站
报价资产波动与监管风险
selling_points_en: Supports custom quote assets (stocks, pre-IPO etc.)
Has standard fee-coin and reward-coin modes
~60% of platform revenue for STONK buyback and burn
selling_points_zh: 支持自定义报价资产（股票、预IPO等）
有标准费币与奖励币模式
约60%平台收入用于STONK回购销毁
内容.team_en: Team is pseudonymous, operates via @LaunchOnSF. Legal entity available on request. Detailed funding not mentioned. Per related guides.
内容.team_zh: 团队化名，通过@LaunchOnSF运营。法律实体可请求提供。资料未提及详细融资。据相关指南。
内容.token_en: Has platform token STONK. ~60% of platform revenue used for open-market buyback and burn. Per reports and API data.
内容.token_zh: 有平台币STONK。约60%平台收入用于公开市场回购并销毁。据报道与API数据。
